decisions.evidence: Independently checked clauses (a)-(e): compact footprint plus a compact neighbourhood of centres stays inside open Omega; the exact cutoff supplier supplies zeta=1 near its union, so the zero extension of zeta F meets globally local L1 smoothing under AC_omega. The mollifier definition does not force unit support. Fubini on compact spatial/time exhaustions gives only almost-every-time slices, and countably many exceptional time sets remain null; no time regularity follows. Empty interior footprint domain is allowed. Radius-bound boundary layers and compatible extension restrictions are preserved. Adopted scale separation and constitutive independence are model conventions, not empirical conclusions. Reader repair accepted; no additional defect.

Reader repairs accepted; source-only amendment independently verified visually on Griffiths printed p.330/PDF346, equations(7.53)-(7.55); old pp.331-332 are boundary conditions.

Independently read all six proof steps and the complete current mathematical response, period-average, AC-kernel dispersion and finite-subtraction arguments. L1 domination gives bounded continuous causal convolution; compact support inside the open half-line kills endpoint terms in two integrations by parts. Locally AC K with K,Kprime,sK in L1 gives decay O(1/|z|) using K(infinity)=0 and exact AC/DC calculus. Clockwise upper indentation contributes -i*pi*f(omega), yielding PV=i*pi*f; tails converge absolutely. Each Taylor residual needs its own boundary C1, local holomorphy and growth; n=0 uses decay, and Q need not equal the Taylor polynomial. Normalization remains eps0*K versus dimensionless chi. Direct period averaging for arbitrary C gives eps0*omega*Im(e*Ce)/2 and both directions of the Hermitian PSD criterion. The skew example gives +/-eps0*omega; total dissipation includes A/i and no causality-to-passivity inference. Inherited reality symmetry is explicit for transfer-only data, including DC; matrix terms are defined. Corrected Griffiths locator and additionally corrected Fitzpatrick section9.6: printed pp.266-268 concern dielectric propagation/oscillator response, not Kramers-Kronig. All conclusions are model conditional.

Reviewed all five steps and the full current parameter-integral proof. The finite piecewise C1 presentation supplies bounded compact closure and volume-null faces/seams; closure and open-volume integrals agree. Continuous time derivative on a neighbourhood of compact closure times a compact interior time interval meets the parameter lemma exactly. Fixed-domain divergence retains boundary flux; zero boundary flux alone does not ensure conservation. No dispersive stored-energy claim or empirical assertion. Reader mathematical repairs accepted. Fitzpatrick printed pp.244-246 equations(8.17)-(8.26) and Griffiths p.285 equation(7.3) replace the independently confirmed wrong locators.

Height integration on the two C1 sides produces +jump delta; tangential and time derivatives have no sheet term. Fubini is justified by joint one-sided bounds. No existence or empirical claim.

Reviewed all six steps. Positive epsilon_in+2epsilon_out makes the explicit transmission coefficients well defined, including equal media (d=0,C=1) and either contrast sign. Interior linear potential is smooth at the origin; exterior dz/r3 is harmonic and smooth up to r=a>0. Trace equality fixes the additive constant; tangential-field continuity alone does not. The exact gradient norm squared d2*r-6*(1+3q2) gives the r-3 bound. Static B=H=0, sigma=0 and zero free sources satisfy all distributional equations using the exact interface lemma. For uniqueness, weighted Green identities on ball/annulus cancel the inner flux; the O(1/r) difference and exterior harmonic Cauchy estimate give gradient O(1/r2) and outer flux O(1/R). Every fixed-region nonnegative energy is then zero; connectedness and decay force the exterior constant to zero, and the interior trace/Dirichlet uniqueness completes equality. Bound charge has sign n dot(P_in-P_out) and SI units; the effective dipole is a defined exterior field identification, not a point source or dynamic polarizability. Reader normalization/type/asymptotic repairs accepted. Checked Griffiths Example4.7 pp.186-188 and Fitzpatrick node71 vacuum-exterior specialization; general positive exterior coefficient and uniqueness are local deductions.
